title: USF Data and Migration Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for data models, persistence contracts, identifiers, relationships, migrations, seed data, fixtures, backup/restore evidence, and retention/deletion concerns. Each declares its kind (data-migration-kinds). Migrations are forward-only and checksum-immutable (a committed migration is never edited); tenancy isolation is preserved; backup/restore emitted and collected evidence (evidence-kinds) is preserved. Governs the ontology concepts Data Model, Migration, and Backup / Restore. lifecycleState draft; not active.

tenancyIsolation.$comment: e.g. schema-per-tenant with RLS; a contract-level invariant.

allOf.$comment: A migration is forward-only and checksum-immutable: it declares its order, a checksum, and immutable=true. A committed migration is never edited.
Backup/restore evidence must preserve emitted and collected evidence (fail closed on missing collected evidence).
